text: In cell lines expressing fluorescently tagged APOE, APOE4 (vs APOE3) accumulated in enlarged lysosomes and late endosomes. This is an endolysosomal abnormality, but endosomal pH was not measured.
description: Cell lines (not named in this commentary; described in Fote et al. J Cell Sci 2022) stably expressing fluorescently tagged APOE3 or APOE4; imaging of APOE localization. Caveat: unspecified cell lines rather than human brain astrocytes; no pH assay; Figure 1 is a schematic, not data.

provenance.excerpt: Consistent with previous studies showing that expression of APOE4 damages lysosomal membrane integrity, dysregulates endo/lysosomal pH, and results in enlarged endosomes in various models, we found that APOE4 accumulates in enlarged lysosomes and late endosomes (Figure 1).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (APOE accumulation in enlarged lysosomes/late endosomes) [surrogate; endosome pH not measured]

perturbed.variable: APOE4 vs APOE3 isoform (fluorescently tagged, expressed in cell lines)

measured.variable: APOE localization to and size of lysosomes and late endosomes
